description: Certified pMCF (path-based maximum-concurrent-flow) all-to-all solves for the three canonical 128-router bundles, with the physical all-to-all cut bound each optimum is measured against.

pt.cut_bound_description: dim2 slab width 4: 32 directed links leave a side of 64 routers

pdtt.cut_bound_description: dim0 slab width 2: 64 directed links leave a side of 64 routers

tons.cut_bound_description: dim0 slab width 2: 64 directed links leave a side of 64 routers

notes: PT all-to-all is bisection-limited: its cut bound 1/128 is reached by the selected DOR routing, so pMCF cannot improve on PT and lands at 8/1025, 99.94% of the physical ceiling.
3544 of PT's 16256 selected DOR routes are absent from the CPL-safe candidate set, which is why the PT pMCF optimum is a hair below 1/128 rather than exactly equal to it.

PDTT and TONS have twice PT's all-to-all cut bound (1/64), which is the source of their A2A advantage; both pMCF optima exceed their own selected-route bounds, so the measured ratios slightly exceed the route-load references 128/74 and 128/72.
These are solver results only. They are not simulated throughput; see the sweep results for measured ASTRA-sim behaviour.
